title: Ankhon me Andhera  hai aaja Ali Akbar
body:
AANKHAAO ME ANDHERA HAI AAJAA ALI AKBAR
<<DIVIDER>>
MILTAA NAHI HAI LAASHAA TERAA ALI AKBAR
Tum chodgaye mujh ko itnaa nahi soncha
Baba zayeef tera ye kaise jiyeegaa
Ab khaak hogayi hai dunyaa Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aayegi mujhe wo akbar ki Jawaani
Karbal me khoogayi hai nana ki nishaani
Taa zindagi hai tujh par rona Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Baad e pisar hua hai baba tera tanhaa
Kaise bhulaao Akbar wo tera tadapnaa
Seene me tere toota naizaa Ali Akbar
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar.. Kyun paao ragadte ho baba ko bataao
Kuch baat karo mujh se Akbar na rulaao
Baba tumhaara dekho aayaa Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ko maa ko armaa shaadi ka bohat tha
Zaqmao se sajj ke aayaa akbar tera laashaa
Ab roti hai Sakina Laila Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas na marta to wo saath me hotaa
Lashe pisar pe baba tanhaa nahi rotaa
Tera nahi milaa hai pursaa Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra ka madine se qatt aaya hua hai
Qatt me bahen ka chehraa murjhaaya hua hai
Zaqmao ne hai banaaya dulhaa Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar..
<<DIVIDER>>
Budha banadiya hai Akbar ki sada ne
Bete ka daagh kya hai wo baap hi jaane
Dawar likhegaa kaise nauhaa Ali Akbar
<<MINI>>
Aankhao me andherahaiaajaa Ali Akbar..
